projects.name: em_inflate
projects.lead: C inflate, zlib licence; README benchmark vs zlib 1.2.11 on a Core i7 with clang 6.0.0 -O3. The original that inflatecpp ports. Lead from the inflatecpp enricher.

projects.name: orz
projects.lead: Rust successor of libzling by the same author; README table vs zstd, xz, brotli, bzip2. Check that its numbers name the baseline versions and machine.

projects.name: m77rip
projects.lead: Credited in misa77's README as the sibling/origin codec; look for its own benchmark vs lz4 or zstd. If it has no numbers, tier D.

projects.name: fast_zlib
projects.lead: Optimised longest_match for zlib (deflate), claims big compression speedups over stock zlib; README has timing tables. Check compression-ratio changes and machine details.

projects.name: jtkukunas/zlib (Intel zlib fork)
projects.lead: Intel's zlib fork with SSE4.2/PCLMUL CRC, deflate_medium and hash improvements; find a numeric comparison vs stock zlib (Intel blog or README). Check whether zlib-ng supersedes it.

projects.name: blz4
projects.lead: Optimal-parsing LZ4 encoder by jibsen (BriefLZ author); README compares compressed size and decode speed against lz4 and lz4hc. Same niche as lz4ultra and smallz4.

projects.name: smallz4
projects.lead: Optimal-parsing LZ4 encoder; the author's page lists compressed sizes and times vs lz4 -9 and lz4ultra on enwik9. The author's site may be blocked; use the repo README.

projects.name: c-blosc2
projects.lead: Blosc2 meta-compressor (shuffle/bitshuffle plus blosclz, lz4, zstd); the README and blog give throughput vs memcpy and vs plain lz4/zstd. Document the strongest comparison with machine and flags.

projects.name: libzbitmap
projects.lead: Open reimplementation of Apple's LZBITMAP codec (lzfse issue #62); look for any numeric comparison vs lzfse or lz4. If none, tier D with caveats.

projects.name: PISA (Performant Indexes and Search for Academia)
projects.lead: Maintained fork of ds2i with Partitioned Elias-Fano, SIMD-BP128, StreamVByte, QMX, MaskedVByte and more; find a decode or query-speed comparison between its codecs and a listed baseline (varint/StreamVByte, SIMD-BP128/FastPFor). Papers may be blocked; use the repo's benchmark docs.

projects.name: hybrid-fenwick-tree
projects.lead: Marchini and Vigna's Fenwick-tree prefix-sum structures (later merged into sux); README or paper tables vs classic Fenwick and SDSL-style structures. Lead from the mutable_rank_select enricher.

projects.name: genedex
projects.lead: Rust FM-index listed as a competitor by the QuadRank sibling repo; look for benchmark numbers vs SDSL or AvxWindowFmIndex.

projects.name: AWRY
projects.lead: Rust port/successor of AvxWindowFmIndex from the same lab; look for numbers vs the C version, SDSL or other FM-indexes.
